values.content:
=You are an expert SEO specialist. Generate optimized meta tags for this web page.

Page URL: {{ $json.body.url || 'Not provided' }}
Page Content: {{ $json.body.content }}
Target Keywords: {{ $json.body.target_keywords || 'Auto-detect' }}
Brand Name: {{ $json.body.brand || '' }}

Generate:
1. SEO Title (50-60 chars, include primary keyword)
2. Meta Description (150-160 chars, compelling with CTA)
3. Primary Keywords (5-8 relevant keywords)
4. Secondary Keywords (5-10 long-tail keywords)
5. Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:type)
6. Twitter Card tags
7. Schema.org structured data suggestion

Return JSON:
{
  "seo_title": "",
  "meta_description": "",
  "primary_keywords": [],
  "secondary_keywords": [],
  "og_title": "",
  "og_description": "",
  "og_type": "article",
  "twitter_title": "",
  "twitter_description": "",
  "twitter_card": "summary_large_image",
  "canonical_url": "",
  "schema_type": "Article",
  "h1_suggestion": "",
  "alt_text_suggestions": ["for any images"],
  "internal_link_suggestions": ["related topics to link to"],
  "readability_score": "A/B/C/D",
  "seo_score": 85
}

parameters.content:
## AI SEO Meta Tag Generator

**Setup:**
1. Connect OpenAI API, Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2
2. Set spreadsheet ID for SEO log
3. POST to webhook: `{"url": "https://example.com/page", "content": "page text content", "target_keywords": "keyword1, keyword2", "brand": "YourBrand", "marketing_email": "team@company.com"}`

Generates SEO title, meta description, keywords, OG tags, Twitter cards, and implementation suggestions. Logs to Sheets and emails marketing team.
